title: 446. Longest Common Prefix Query
description:
nts & Solutions
Submissions
446
. 
Longest Common Prefix Query
50
Medium
Topics
Problem Statement:
Peter wants to play a game with you.He gives you N strings as S[1] S[2] S[3]....S[N] and he will ask you Q questions In each question he will give you a number M and X. He wants to know if the longest common prefix of the first M strings has length at least X If it is greater than or equal to X report to him “Yes” or report to him “No” 
Input Description:
The first line contains a single integer N denoting the number of strings he will give you initially The next N line contains a single string per line The next line contains a single integer Q denoting the number of questions he will ask you The next Q line contains two integers M X denoting the number of strings from the first string he wants you to consider and the length he wants it to have respectively 
Output Description:
Your output must consist of Q lines each line containing one of the following : “Yes” or “No” 
Explanation:
The longest common prefix for first two strings is abcde which has length 5 > 4 so answer is “Yes” The longest common prefix for first three strings is ab , which has length 2 < 4 so answer is “No” 
Sample Input:
3
abcdefg
abcde
abd
2
2 4
3 4 
Sample Output:
Yes
No
